verdict.rationale: Rainforest shows per-merchant application states such as **Needs Information** (surfaced via webhooks and Zapier events), and some onboarding verifications can be configured to run before submission. There is no evidence of progressive or tiered onboarding that lets sellers start processing on minimal data and defers the remaining requirements until a payout threshold; onboarding appears to be a single application reviewed through underwriting. Missing for 10: tunable minimum-to-start-selling onboarding, payout-threshold-gated requirement collection, per-seller requirements-due lists with deadlines, independent corroboration.
